block.frostworks.vent.tooltip.summary: Blows the cold of a _cold fluid_ into a cold room.
block.frostworks.vent.tooltip.behaviour1: The room goes down to _−10 °C_: its machines may turn _25 % faster_ than Create allows (_320 RPM_ by default).
block.frostworks.vent.tooltip.behaviour2: The room goes down to _−20 °C_: its machines may turn _50 % faster_ than Create allows (_384 RPM_ by default).
block.frostworks.cold_wall.tooltip.summa: Closes a _cold room_. A closed, cooled room lets its machines go past Create's _speed limit_.
block.frostworks.cold_wall.tooltip.behav: Shows the room's state, its temperature and what it is missing.
Lets the player walk through without _opening the cold room_.
block.frostworks.cryo_infuser.tooltip.su: A press that _infuses with cold_. Holds _one fluid_ at a time: cold gas or Frosium.
block.frostworks.cryo_infuser.tooltip.co: Above a Depot or a Belt
block.frostworks.cryo_infuser.tooltip.be: Chills the item, with cold gas or Frosium as the recipe says.
Freezes it into _ice_, with cold gas.
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.replace: In a closed cold room, takes the place of the %s recipe
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.bonus: In a closed cold room, added to every %s recipe
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.replace_a: Takes the place of the %s recipe, better in a closed cold room
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.bonus_any: Added to every %s recipe, more in a closed cold room
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.bonus_one: In a closed cold room, added to this %s recipe
Added to this %s recipe, more in a closed cold room
frostworks.jei.cold_processing.replaces_: (in place of the recipe's last roll)
frostworks.ponder.chilled_ores.text_1: With %1$s mB of Frosium in its second tank, the Cryogenic Infuser chills an ore: Raw Iron comes out Chilled Raw Iron.
frostworks.ponder.chilled_ores.text_2: Create's Crushing Wheels crush it as Raw Iron, and give one more Crushed Raw Iron %1$s %% of the time.
frostworks.ponder.chilled_ores.text_3: The colder the room the wheels are in, the more often: %1$s %% in a room on cold gas (%2$s °C)...
frostworks.ponder.compressor.text_1: The Compressor turns rotation into cold gas, which leaves through its front. It needs at least %1$s RPM.
frostworks.ponder.compressor.text_2: The stress it takes is set on its mark, from %1$s to %2$s su by steps of %3$s. The network sees exactly that, whatever the speed.
frostworks.ponder.compressor.text_3: The more it takes, the more gas it makes: %1$s mB per second at %2$s su.
frostworks.ponder.cryo_infuser.text_1: Turning is not enough: without cold gas, the Infuser does not come down.
frostworks.ponder.cryo_infuser.text_2: With rotation and cold gas (into its side), it comes down on the item below and holds it %1$s s: %2$s mB of gas turn Dried Kelp into Chilled Dried Kelp.
frostworks.ponder.cryo_infuser.text_3: An Iron Sheet takes %1$s mB and comes out a Cold Iron Sheet.
frostworks.ponder.cryo_infuser.text_4: Over a Basin, it freezes what is in it: %1$s mB of water and %2$s mB of cold gas make one Ice, which comes out of the basin as the press's results do.
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_1: The tower stands on a base of 2 x 2 Column Bases; each one takes the shape of its corner.
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_2: Frost Tanks set 2 x 2 on the base become the column, up to %1$s layers with the base. Each layer handles %2$s mB of gas a second at %3$s RPM; each column block holds %4$s mB, the base nothing.
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_3: In: rotation on a side of the base, cold gas and water through pipes on the base (pumped: the tower pulls nothing).
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_4: The tower also needs ice, the matter its Frosium is made of: through a side of the base, by funnel or mechanical arm. A Packed Ice gives %1$s mB; plain Ice counts for a ninth, Blue Ice for nine.
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_5: Without ice, the tower stops (nothing breaks); its goggles say so, with the ice left.
frostworks.ponder.cryogenic_tower.text_6: Out: Frosium, drawn from the base by a pump, into a Frost Tank.
frostworks.ponder.frost_tank.text_1: The Frost Tank holds cold liquids: Frosium, and any liquid tagged frostworks:cold_liquid. %1$s mB a block, %2$s here.
frostworks.ponder.frost_tank.text_2: Any other fluid stays out. Create's Fluid Tanks, for their part, refuse Frosium.
frostworks.ponder.expander.text_1: The Expander takes Frosium in at its back: %1$s mB a second. The cold gas leaves at its front.
frostworks.ponder.expander.text_2: It turns nothing by itself: it adds %1$s su of capacity, through the shaft across it, to the network that already turns (a Hand Crank here), at any speed.
frostworks.ponder.expander.text_3: The share given as rotation is set on it, 0 to 100 %%; the rest leaves the front as cold gas: %1$s su and %2$s mB a second at %3$s %%.
frostworks.ponder.cold_vent.text_1: When cold air comes out, the vent is on: it cools the closed room it blows into.
frostworks.ponder.cold_vent.text_2: A vent covers %1$s cells with cold gas, %2$s with Frosium.
frostworks.ponder.cold_vent.text_3: The room is cold when the total capacity of its vents reaches its volume: %1$s cells here, for %2$s.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_1: Cold Walls connect to each other. They close off the room you want to keep cold.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_2: A Cold Vent takes the place of a wall. It spreads into the room the cold that reaches it through its pipe.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_3: The room is cold when the capacity of its vents covers its volume. Engineer's Goggles, on a wall, tell where it stands.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_4: The Strip Curtain Door counts as a wall, yet you walk through it: players, villagers, animals. The cold does not get out.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_5: A hole in a wall opens the room: the cold escapes.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_6: To take a shaft, a pipe or a belt through a wall, right-click it with a Cold Wall. The passage counts as a wall: the room stays closed.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_build.text_7: Walls, vents, door and passages: that is all a cold room needs.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.header: Going Faster in a Cold Room
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_1: In Create, a machine does not go faster than %1$s RPM.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_2: A Compressor feeds the vent with cold gas. The temperature of the room drops.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_3: Once the room is cold, it allows %1$s RPM. Motor at %2$s RPM, gears at ×2: the machine turns at %1$s.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_4: With Frosium, the room goes down to %1$s °C and allows %2$s RPM.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_5: In a closed cold room, machines also take less stress: %1$s %% less from %2$s °C, %3$s %% less from %4$s °C. Frostworks' own machines keep theirs.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_speed.text_6: If the cold goes away, the room turns normal again after a grace period: Create's rule applies and gears that are too fast break.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_belt.header: A Belt Between Two Cold Rooms
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_belt.text_1: A belt can leave a Cold Room through a belt passage and go into another Cold Room.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_belt.text_2: At %1$s RPM it holds as long as both of its ends are in the cold. The part in between, out in the open, does not matter.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_belt.text_3: If one of its ends is out of the cold, the belt breaks.
frostworks.ponder.cold_room_belt.text_4: A shaft put on the belt out of the cold turns too fast there: the belt breaks at that point.
block.frostworks.expander.tooltip.summar: Gives stored rotation back: turns _Frosium_ into _stress capacity_.
block.frostworks.expander.tooltip.behavi: Turns the shaft through it, and lets out cold gas.
